meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning skill. Self-orchestrates 5 hostile category members (unspecified-low, unspecified-high, deep, ultrabrain, artistry) via team-mode for ruthless cross-critique debate, distills only the defensible insights, then MANDATORILY hands the distilled insight bundle to the `plan` agent for executable plan formalization. Use when planning needs maximum rigor and surfacing of weak assumptions, blind spots, and over-engineering. Triggers: 'hyperplan', 'hpp', '/hyperplan', 'adversarial plan', 'hostile planning', 'cross-critique plan', '하이퍼플랜', '적대적 계획', '교차 비평'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用多智能体对抗辩论提炼规划洞察，生成可执行方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在规划时暴露弱假设并避免盲点
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to surface weak assumptions and blind spots in your planning process

howto.what: 加载后 Claude 成为 Lead,组建 5 名互相敌对的成员开展交叉批评辩论,只留下经得起攻击的洞见,再强制交给 `plan` agent 形成可执行计划。开始时会先说 “HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!”。
howto.when: 当你说 “hyperplan”、“hpp”、“adversarial plan” 等关键词时触发;需在主会话中运行,且 team_* 工具可用、当前为 sisyphus 等 lead 身份,否则会停下并说明。

say.text: hyperplan:帮我制定 <需求> 的实施方案
say.note: 启动对抗式多智能体规划

say.text: 用敌对规划审一下我这份计划,找出过度设计和盲点
/hyperplan 把这次重构拆成可执行步骤
say.note: 最终交给 plan agent 出计划

howto.what_en: Once loaded, Claude becomes Lead of 5 mutually hostile category members that cross-critique each other; only defensible insights survive, then the bundle is mandatorily handed to the `plan` agent for an executable plan. It first says "HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!".
howto.when_en: Triggers on 'hyperplan', 'hpp', 'adversarial plan', etc. Runs only in the main session with team_* tools available and as a lead agent such as sisyphus.

say_en.text: hyperplan: draft an implementation plan for <requirement>
Hostile-plan review my plan and expose over-engineering and blind spots
/hyperplan break this refactor into executable steps
